**Correction to this PR's description.** "Codex review: 0 blockers, 0 high, its 1 medium fixed" describes only one separate review, pinned to `2aa77ee0a`. It wasn't full acceptance of this merged tree.

An independent Codex pager review had two medium findings open at merge, both still in this code:
- **Pager cutoff:** the matchup pager could show a different default week from the loaded edition around midnight, and a failed calendar refresh gave no warning.
- **Standouts slates:** a played slate with a missing skater feed reads "No completed games" and the slate pager skips it.

Fixes are in progress on `octoberBranch` and will ship with the next release. Also, the description's real-data renders didn't exercise the pager: the capture script didn't supply the calendar, so 13 of the 17 render reports showed "Weeks unavailable". A re-capture with a real calendar is underway.

Correction to this PR's description. "Codex review: 0 blockers, 0 high, its 1 medium fixed" describes only one separate review, pinned to 2aa77ee0a. It wasn't full acceptance of this merged tree.

An independent Codex pager review had two medium findings open at merge, both still in this code:

  • Pager cutoff: the matchup pager could show a different default week from the loaded edition around midnight, and a failed calendar refresh gave no warning.
  • Standouts slates: a played slate with a missing skater feed reads "No completed games" and the slate pager skips it.

Fixes are in progress on octoberBranch and will ship with the next release. Also, the description's real-data renders didn't exercise the pager: the capture script didn't supply the calendar, so 13 of the 17 render reports showed "Weeks unavailable". A re-capture with a real calendar is underway.
